seed: Objects of type `player` under action ACTION4 with touching neighbours [] show mixed outcomes: no_change x5, x x5. Find the condition in the before state that decides the outcome. Start from this kind of condition: the exact click position relative to the object, when the action is a click. Verify it against every transition before you keep it.

Player 5x5 moves 5 cells; dest box with wall colour 4 / void 5 / off-board is blocked, but the move still burns bar.
Colour-1 5-cell strip on a dest cell edge = conveyor: slide away from it until blocked.
Each action: leftmost 2 bar cells 11->3 (rows 61-62); refuel ring inside dest is consumed + bar refilled.
'collect' target inside dest rotates the 3x3 HUD glyph 90deg CW; cells under the player are remembered (gated on frame continuity) and restored. Stateless gets 38/40.
Hypothesis: A4 no-ops come from wall cells (colour 4) ahead, not click position. Chamber free-reject and unlock condition not observed.
